name: Ownership
eligibility: A household appliance acquired by purchase, gift or transfer. Seller, price and order reference apply to purchases.

name: Warranty
eligibility: A product covered by a manufacturer warranty, including expired cover retained for reference.

name: Extended warranty
eligibility: A product with a separately purchased extended warranty. Its coverage dates and provider belong to this cover.

name: Support
eligibility: A product with a support channel or manufacturer support registration.

name: Maintenance
eligibility: A product with a documented recurring service requirement. Intervals describe the maintenance terms.

name: Appliance
eligibility: A household appliance, including products with multiple functions.

name: Serial number
eligibility: An appliance carrying a unit serial identifier other than a Z-Nr marking. BSH Z-Nr markings belong to the matching manufacturer identifier set.

name: Bosch identifiers
eligibility: A Bosch household appliance whose rating plate provides E-Nr, FD or Z-Nr markings.

name: Neff identifiers
eligibility: A Neff household appliance whose rating plate provides E-Nr, FD or Z-Nr markings.

name: Siemens identifiers
eligibility: A Siemens household appliance whose rating plate provides E-Nr, FD or Z-Nr markings.

name: Product number
eligibility: An AEG, Electrolux or Zanussi appliance with a PNC on its product label.

name: Installation
eligibility: An installed or fitted appliance with installation details or clearance requirements.

name: Dimensions
eligibility: An appliance with specified external dimensions.

name: Installation opening
eligibility: A built-in appliance requiring a specified installation opening.

name: Electrical supply
eligibility: An electrically powered appliance with specified supply and connection requirements.

name: Energy label
eligibility: An appliance carrying an energy label. Use the overall energy class only where a single product-level class is provided; separate wash and complete-cycle classes belong to the relevant function sets.

name: Washing
eligibility: A washing machine or the washing component of a washer-dryer.

name: Drying
eligibility: A tumble dryer or the drying component of a washer-dryer.

name: Wash-and-dry cycle
eligibility: A combination washer-dryer with measurements for its complete wash-and-dry cycle.

name: Dishwasher
eligibility: A household dishwasher with eco-cycle consumption specifications.

name: Refrigeration
eligibility: A refrigerator or the chilled compartment of a fridge-freezer.

name: Freezer
eligibility: A freezer or the frozen compartment of a fridge-freezer.

name: Water filter
eligibility: An appliance with a replaceable drinking-water filter, including filtered-water refrigerators.

name: Oven
eligibility: An oven or the oven component of a cooker or combination appliance. Second-oven capacity applies to products with a second cavity.

name: Hob
eligibility: A hob or the hob component of a range cooker.

name: Cooking output
eligibility: A cooking appliance whose specification states delivered output power, including microwave output.

name: Heating
eligibility: A boiler, heat pump or other appliance providing space heating.

name: Cooling
eligibility: An air conditioner or heat pump providing cooling.

name: Hot water storage
eligibility: An appliance incorporating a hot-water storage cylinder.

name: Fuel
eligibility: A fuel-burning appliance, including cooking and heating equipment.

name: Refrigerant
eligibility: Heating or cooling equipment with a refrigerant circuit.

name: Water reservoir
eligibility: A small appliance with a refillable water reservoir, including coffee machines and steam appliances.

name: Vacuum cleaner
eligibility: A vacuum cleaner or cleaning robot with a dust container.

name: Consumables
eligibility: An appliance requiring identifiable replacement filters, bags, cartridges or cleaning supplies.

name: Cleaning
eligibility: An appliance with documented cleaning instructions or a recurring cleaning interval.

name: Descaling
eligibility: An appliance whose instructions require periodic descaling.

name: Ownership
eligibility: A device acquired by purchase, gift or transfer. Seller, price and order reference apply to purchases.

name: Warranty
eligibility: A product covered by a manufacturer warranty, including expired cover retained for reference.

name: Extended warranty
eligibility: A product with a separately purchased extended warranty. Its coverage dates and provider belong to this cover.

name: Support
eligibility: A product with a support channel or manufacturer support registration.

name: Maintenance
eligibility: A product with a documented recurring service requirement. Intervals describe the maintenance terms.

name: Device
eligibility: An electronic device with manufacturer and model identity.

name: System software
eligibility: A device with an operating system or firmware version that its owner can identify.

name: Computing and storage
eligibility: A computer, phone, tablet, console or network storage device with computing or storage specifications.

name: Cellular hardware
eligibility: A phone, tablet, wearable or modem with cellular hardware. Line 2 and EID apply only to devices exposing those identities.

name: Battery and charging
eligibility: A device powered by a battery or equipped with a charging input.

name: Network connection
eligibility: A network-connected device with a hostname or identifiable network interfaces.

name: Wi-Fi
eligibility: A device with a Wi-Fi radio.

name: Smart home compatibility
eligibility: A smart-home device with a declared interoperability or control protocol.

name: Display
eligibility: A television, monitor or device with an integrated display or video connectors.

name: Display mounting
eligibility: A display with a VESA mounting pattern.

name: Printer
eligibility: A printer or the printing component of a multifunction device. Colour consumables apply to colour printers.

name: Scanner
eligibility: A scanner or the scanning component of a multifunction device with a document feeder.

name: Camera
eligibility: A camera, interchangeable lens or recording device with the relevant lens, card or recording-storage feature.

name: Dimensions
eligibility: A device with declared physical dimensions or weight.

name: Operating environment
eligibility: A device with a declared ingress-protection rating or operating-temperature range.

name: Ownership
eligibility: A vehicle acquired by purchase, gift or transfer. Seller, price and order reference apply to purchases.

name: Warranty
eligibility: A product covered by a manufacturer warranty, including expired cover retained for reference.

name: Extended warranty
eligibility: A product with a separately purchased extended warranty. Its coverage dates and provider belong to this cover.

name: Support
eligibility: A product with a support channel or manufacturer support registration.

name: Maintenance
eligibility: A product with a documented recurring service requirement. Intervals describe the maintenance terms.

name: Vehicle
eligibility: A road vehicle, cycle, trailer or watercraft with manufacturer and model identity.

name: Manufacturer serial number
eligibility: A vehicle with a manufacturer serial number distinct from its VIN, frame number or hull identifier.

name: Registration
eligibility: A vehicle registered with a road or vessel authority.

name: VIN
eligibility: A vehicle assigned a vehicle identification number.

name: Road vehicle specifications
eligibility: A motorised road vehicle, including cars, vans, motorcycles and motorhomes.

name: Car
eligibility: A passenger car. Seating capacity includes the driver.

name: Van
eligibility: A van or pickup used to carry goods. Cargo specifications describe its load space.

name: Combustion engine
eligibility: A road vehicle with a combustion engine, including hybrid vehicles.

name: Roadworthiness
eligibility: A vehicle subject to an applicable roadworthiness inspection scheme.

name: Distance-based servicing
eligibility: A vehicle with a manufacturer service interval expressed as distance.

name: Roof load
eligibility: A vehicle with a manufacturer-declared roof load limit.

name: Permitted mass
eligibility: A vehicle or trailer with a plated maximum authorised mass. Gross train weight applies to towing vehicles with a combined mass limit.

name: Towing limits
eligibility: A vehicle approved to tow trailers with stated braked or unbraked limits.

name: Electric drive
eligibility: A battery-electric or plug-in hybrid road vehicle. DC specifications apply where DC charging is supported.

name: Traction battery warranty
eligibility: A road vehicle with separate traction-battery warranty terms.

name: Bicycle
eligibility: A bicycle, cargo cycle or electrically assisted bicycle.

name: E-bike battery
eligibility: An electrically assisted cycle with a battery pack.

name: Motorcycle
eligibility: A motorcycle or motor scooter. Chain specification applies to chain-driven models.

name: Living accommodation
eligibility: A caravan, motorhome or campervan fitted with accommodation. Tank capacities apply where the tanks are fitted.

name: Watercraft
eligibility: A boat or personal watercraft. Engine serial number applies to motorised craft.

name: Vehicle finance
eligibility: A leased or financed vehicle. Mileage terms apply where specified by the agreement.

name: Account
eligibility: A membership with a provider-managed account. Account identity is distinct from the specific plan or membership identity.

name: Support
eligibility: An account with customer-support contact information.

name: Billing
eligibility: A service with a recurring contractual charge or stated billing and payment terms.

name: Commitment and cancellation
eligibility: A service with a minimum commitment period, cancellation notice or cancellation process.

name: Membership
eligibility: Membership of an organisation, club or scheme. Term-end and auto-renewal details apply to memberships with those terms.

name: Members
eligibility: A joint, family or group membership with named people.

name: Access code
eligibility: A membership using a private access PIN.

name: Museum and heritage membership
eligibility: Membership of a museum, gallery, heritage organisation, zoo or attraction offering venue or visitor benefits.

name: Sports and leisure membership
eligibility: A gym, pool, sports club or leisure membership with venue-access terms. Classes, guests, freezing and lockers apply where offered.

name: Professional membership
eligibility: A professional association, union or accreditation membership. Registration, CPD and accreditation dates apply where required.

name: Borrowing membership
eligibility: A library or lending-club membership with borrowing entitlements.

name: Loyalty programme
eligibility: A loyalty or travel-club membership with a loyalty identifier or status tier.

name: Workspace membership
eligibility: A coworking space or makerspace membership with access or usage allowances. Induction applies where required.

name: Account
eligibility: A subscription with a provider-managed account. Account identity is distinct from the specific plan or membership identity.

name: Support
eligibility: An account with customer-support contact information.

name: Billing
eligibility: A service with a recurring contractual charge or stated billing and payment terms.

name: Commitment and cancellation
eligibility: A service with a minimum commitment period, cancellation notice or cancellation process.

name: Subscription
eligibility: A recurring or fixed-term subscription with a named plan. Access-end and auto-renewal details apply according to its terms.

name: Trial
eligibility: A subscription with a fixed trial period.

name: Introductory offer
eligibility: A subscription with a time-limited introductory price and a stated subsequent price.

name: Included services
eligibility: A subscription bundling more than one service. Each service-specific entitlement set applies independently.

name: Streaming
eligibility: A video, music or gaming-streaming subscription with plan-specific playback entitlements. Video quality applies to video services.

name: Software licence
eligibility: A software subscription with licensed-user, activation or licence-type terms. Licence key applies where activation requires a private key.

name: Cloud storage
eligibility: A cloud service with a storage allowance or contractually selected storage region.

name: Usage allowance
eligibility: A metered subscription with a recurring quota, reset rule or overage price.

name: Deliveries
eligibility: A print publication, meal kit, consumable or other subscription supplying regular physical deliveries.

name: Domain registration
eligibility: A subscription registering a single domain name. Each domain with distinct registration terms needs its own Thing.

name: Website hosting
eligibility: A website or application hosting subscription.

name: Backups
eligibility: A subscription providing backups with a defined retention period.

name: Service plan
eligibility: A maintenance or household-service subscription covering an identified item or property with included visits.

name: Monitoring
eligibility: An alarm or monitoring subscription. Recording retention applies to plans storing recordings.

name: Emergency response
eligibility: A service subscription with a stated emergency-response commitment.

name: Account
eligibility: A utility service with a provider-managed account. Account identity is distinct from the specific plan or membership identity.

name: Support
eligibility: An account with customer-support contact information.

name: Billing
eligibility: A service with a recurring contractual charge or stated billing and payment terms.

name: Commitment and cancellation
eligibility: A service with a minimum commitment period, cancellation notice or cancellation process.

name: Utility service
eligibility: A utility account serving a property or providing a telecommunications service. Supply address applies to location-bound services.

name: Tariff terms
eligibility: An account with tariff-wide terms. In a bundle, use this set only for terms shared by all included services; service-specific terms belong to their service sets.

name: Electricity supply
eligibility: An electricity supply, including the electricity component of a dual-fuel account. Meter details apply to the associated import meter.

name: Electricity rates
eligibility: An electricity tariff with contractual import rates and standing charges. The single unit rate applies to single-rate tariffs; effective date and tax basis qualify the prices.

name: Electricity supply identity (GB)
eligibility: An electricity supply in Great Britain identified by an MPAN.

name: Electricity supply identity (Portugal)
eligibility: An electricity supply in Portugal identified by a CPE.

name: Time-of-use electricity
eligibility: An electricity tariff with contractual peak and off-peak rates and time windows.

name: Dynamic tariff reference
eligibility: An electricity tariff whose variable settlement-period prices are published at a stable provider URL. Store the reference URL here.

name: Electricity export
eligibility: An electricity supply with an export agreement and any separately assigned export meter point.

name: Contracted power
eligibility: An electricity contract specifying a contracted-power tier, including Portuguese electricity contracts.

name: Gas supply
eligibility: A gas supply, including the gas component of a dual-fuel account. Meter units describe the physical meter.

name: Gas rates
eligibility: A gas tariff with contractual unit rates and standing charges. Effective date and tax basis qualify the prices.

name: Gas supply identity (GB)
eligibility: A gas supply in Great Britain identified by an MPRN.

name: Electricity and gas
eligibility: One account supplying both electricity and gas to the same service location.

name: Water supply
eligibility: A clean-water supply account. Fixed charge and effective date apply where published.

name: Metered water
eligibility: A water supply billed using a physical meter.

name: Unmetered water
eligibility: A water account billed using a property rateable value.

name: Wastewater
eligibility: A service charging for wastewater collection or treatment. Unit rate applies to usage-based charging.

name: Broadband
eligibility: A broadband service, including the broadband component of a telecommunications bundle. Speeds are contractual specifications.

name: Landline
eligibility: A fixed telephone service, including the landline component of a bundle.

name: Mobile service
eligibility: A mobile phone or mobile-data contract. Roaming, calls and spending caps apply where offered.

name: Handset repayments
eligibility: A mobile contract with a separately priced handset repayment agreement.

name: Heat network
eligibility: A metered district or communal heating supply.

name: Delivered fuel
eligibility: A heating-oil or LPG supply delivered by volume to an associated storage tank.

name: Waste collection
eligibility: A waste-collection service with an allocated container.

name: Policy
eligibility: An insurance policy or separately identified cover agreement. Brokers and underwriters apply where identified.

name: Insured people
eligibility: A policy covering named people.

name: Premium and payment
eligibility: A policy with a quoted annual premium or instalment agreement.

name: Claims and assistance
eligibility: A policy with claim-submission or emergency-assistance contact channels.

name: Insured property
eligibility: Home cover referring to a single insured property address, shared by any buildings and contents components.

name: Buildings cover
eligibility: Insurance covering a building structure, including the buildings component of combined home cover.

name: Contents cover
eligibility: Insurance covering possessions, including the contents component of combined home cover. Limits and excesses apply to this component.

name: Buildings and contents
eligibility: One policy covering both a building and its contents at the same insured property.

name: Specified possession
eligibility: A contents policy with exactly one individually scheduled possession whose description and value are recorded together. Multiple scheduled possessions require a repeated-item model before mapping this section.

name: Motor cover
eligibility: Motor cover for one insured vehicle with one set of cover and excess terms. Per-vehicle differences in multi-vehicle policies require a repeated-vehicle model before mapping this section.

name: Travel cover
eligibility: Travel insurance or the travel component of a bundled policy. Benefit limits retain their per-person or per-claim basis.

name: Pet cover
eligibility: Pet insurance for one insured pet and one set of cover terms. Per-pet differences in multi-pet policies require a repeated-pet model before mapping this section.

name: Medical cover
eligibility: Private medical insurance, including a medical component with its own benefits and underwriting terms.

name: Dental cover
eligibility: A policy or policy component providing dental cover with an annual limit. Waiting-period end applies to this dental benefit where specified.

name: Life cover
eligibility: Life assurance with one life-assured value and one set of cover terms. Term-end applies to fixed-term cover.

name: Critical illness cover
eligibility: A policy or policy component paying a stated critical-illness benefit.

name: Income protection
eligibility: Income protection with monthly benefits, a deferred period and defined payment-duration and incapacity terms.

name: Breakdown cover
eligibility: Standalone breakdown cover or the breakdown component of another policy.

name: Home emergency cover
eligibility: Standalone home-emergency cover or an emergency component of home insurance.

name: Gadget cover
eligibility: Cover for one identified gadget with one per-item limit. Multiple gadgets with different terms require a repeated-item model before mapping this section.

name: Public liability
eligibility: A policy or component providing a stated public-liability limit.

name: Legal expenses
eligibility: A policy or component providing a stated legal-expenses limit.
